Sofia — quick technical summary and proposed deliverables.

1) EU-only processing: For a Redwood Private deployment in Azure (customer VNet + Private Link/ExpressRoute), compute and persistent storage are placed in the customer’s Azure subscription in West Europe; Redwood’s control plane coordinates the service but we can restrict logs/metrics export to EU regions and avoid cross-region backups. For pilot mode we can commit to region-bound processing and storage; full attestation language below (Laura, please review).

2) Peering options:
   - Private Link (recommended): Redwood exposes a Private Endpoint in the customer subscription. Minimal routing changes on customer side, no BGP required.
   - ExpressRoute: supported if customer prefers circuit-level peering; requires ASN/BGP; good for high-throughput.

Technical requirements (high level):
   - Allowed outbound IPs from customer side: see attached network-diagram_vpc_peering.png (we also include IP ranges in the diagram).
   - Ports: 443 outbound for control plane and optional 5228 for agent telemetry (can be disabled for pilot).
   - Keys: Customer can bring-managed keys (Azure Key Vault). We do not export encryption keys outside the configured region.

Attachments included: redwood_SOC2_report-2026.pdf (redacted), network-diagram_vpc_peering.png, SIG-questionnaire-complete.xlsx.

HubSpot/Deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/52341 — will reference when we send attestation.

Draft attestation for legal to vet: 
"Redwood Inference confirms that, for the ClinicaPilot pilot engagement, all customer data processed as part of the pilot will be stored and processed in Microsoft Azure West Europe. Redwood will not transfer, replicate, or persist customer data outside the European Economic Area for the duration of the pilot. Logs and backups will be stored in West Europe and encryption keys will remain in-region when using customer-managed key options. Any exception to the above will be documented and require written approval by ClinicaPilot."

Let me know if you want a stronger contractual clause; otherwise we can send this as an attestation letter and the attachments to Anna.

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
